info.title: Niu Customer Workspace & Billing Management API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/help/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/help/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session,
platform authority or Provider membership stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` path segments refer to workspaces; legacy `provider` paths refer to Providers.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units; Provider purchase rates and customer charges are separate.

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

post.summary: Restore original consumed Credits ranges
post.description: Platform administration required. Restores the next unrefunded prefix of an original resolved charge. Original source, definition and expiry remain unchanged; expired restored units stay expired. Purchase conversion and current tariffs are never used. Identical idempotent replay returns the original immutable receipt; conflicting replay and cumulative over-refund are rejected. Concurrent refunds serialize on the unit account. This does not execute an external payment refund, reverse a purchase, or release an unresolved inference hold. No monetary backing or procurement information is returned. Quantities are exact decimal strings.

get.summary: Read exact Credits quantities by original definition and provenance
get.description: Organization-wide billing owner/admin or installation read access required. One database statement reports original issuance, unresolved held ranges, gross charged ranges, original-range restorations, expired unheld remainder and available unexpired remainder. Expiry never releases an unresolved request hold or renews a restored lot. For each group, issued + restored = held + charged + expired + available. A balance is not proof that inference routes, tariffs or admission are configured. Historical unit definitions remain separate. No payment backing, procurement rates or financial margin enters this response. Quantities are exact decimal strings; an empty array means no issuance. Reads do not activate Credits or convert monetary balances.

get.summary: List saved workspace materials
get.description: Member Read permission required. Scope is the selected workspace, not the creating actor. Lists active objects with metadata only, ordered by creation time then identity. limit defaults to 50 and must be 1–100. after must be an active asset in the same workspace and kind filter or conflicts. Follow next_cursor; separate pages are not a frozen snapshot. No ciphertext, actor identifier, Provider URI, procurement or dispatch approval is returned. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

post.summary: Save a workspace material
post.description: Member Write permission required. Raw binary body with exact supported Content-Type and required name query; no multipart or base64 envelope. Authentication and a bounded upload slot precede body collection. Original bytes are immutable, encrypted with workspace/asset identity binding, limited to 8 MiB each and 256 MiB/256 active objects per workspace. Images undergo bounded pixel decoding; audio/video undergo local frame/container structural validation. This is not content-inspection approval, Provider upload, licensing evidence or inference authorization. Repeated uploads create distinct objects; uncertain clients should reconcile the library before repeating. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

get.summary: List personal saved Chat history or one continuation page
get.description: Without limit or after, retain the latest-100 compatibility response. Either paging parameter selects a bounded page, default 50, ordered by updated time and ID descending within the authenticated owner, workspace and archive state. Session payload and customer-charge hydration share a read-only snapshot with 250 ms lock and 2 s statement limits. A changed, deleted, foreign-owner or different-archive cursor returns 409; pages are live views, not a frozen cross-request snapshot. Before loading saved bodies, paging also limits the sum of saved JSON text bytes to 32 MiB and may return fewer rows than limit; follow next_cursor. Customer-charge hydration can increase wire size. Legacy latest-100 calls over that saved-payload budget return 413 rather than truncated success. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

put.summary: Save an owned Chat session in a workspace
put.description: Requires workspace write access. Stores conversation content separately from accounting. Only supported top-level and nested fields are retained. Client-supplied accounting fields are discarded. Numeric timestamps, durations and token counts must be nonnegative JavaScript-safe integers; token counts may be null. Settings and attachment shapes are validated. This endpoint does not establish authoritative request charges or detect secrets embedded in conversation text. Omit expectedRevision for a compatibility write only while the owned record has not enabled guarded writes. Explicit null creates only if no owned row exists; a canonical positive decimal revision updates only that exact owned version. Stale, missing or duplicate-create guarded writes return 409 without replacing content. Revisions are global sequence values, not timestamps, and are never reused by API delete/recreate. Guarded success includes a decimal revision; direct GET provides it. A successful guarded creation/update permanently enables guarded writes on that owned row. Compatibility saves thereafter return 409; there is no content-write downgrade. A content-free guard identity survives deletion, so legacy autosaves cannot resurrect a protected reference; explicit null guarded creation may recreate it. Untouched legacy rows retain compatibility behavior until guarded save. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

post.summary: Explicitly save a generated output into workspace materials
post.description: Current dashboard workspace Write permission and actor-visible original task required. Task/output identity is scoped; no Provider URLs, private references, credentials or costs are returned. Explicit bounded copy into the existing encrypted workspace material library, not Provider registration or generation. Cached mode uses unexpired saved references under historical access; fresh mode explicitly queries the original task then retrieves output, using optional selected current workspace key or original-key fallback. The selected key cannot replace the immutable Provider/account/model/channel. Original expired keys without explicit current authority refuse fresh actions. Upstream operations never retry automatically. Two process capture slots; transport and format validation limited to8MiB; existing256asset/256MiB workspace quotas remain. A durable2minute preparing lease is committed before retrieval. Only an explicit repeated POST recovers failed/expired claims. Same requestid with changed fields409; a NEW requestid may change mode after failure; source identity prevents duplicate active/stored captures. Stored source replay returns canonical retained/deleted outcome without network; deleted retained bytes are never resurrected. Asset bytes, source provenance, quota and audit commit atomically after rechecking visibility under the source task lock. Failed delivery returns its error and retains a safe failed claim when storage is available; ambiguous failure-record writes leave preparing, not false availability. Cached expiry/deletion and original task/pricing identity are not rewritten. Fresh status queries may append diagnosis and settle an original pending liability through existing recovery, never create a new generation or reprice it. Saving shares copied bytes with authorized workspace members through the existing library; Provider readiness and verified identity remain separate. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.
